messages.content: 找出兩組變量之間的統計顯著性，其中dataset_A的值為12、24、36，dataset_B的值為15、30、45。

function.name: t_test
function.description: Perform a statistical t-test to check if the means of two independent datasets are statistically different. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

alpha.description: Significance level for the test. Default is 0.05. This is a float type value.

We need to call it with dataset_A [12,24,36] and dataset_B [15,30,45]. The default alpha=0.05 unless specified otherwise. So we should use the tool.

We'll produce JSON output as required. We'll pass arguments accordingly. Then return result from tool? But here the tool likely returns some structure. Since we don't know exactly what the tool returns, but presumably it will compute t-statistic, degrees of freedom, p-value, conclusion. We could simply forward whatever the tool gives.

Thus I think best approach: Call the tool with those arrays. Return the tool's output directly. No extra commentary. Ensure correct JSON formatting. Also ensure we follow the rule: "When you invoke a tool, you MUST NOT add anything other than the tool invocation itself." Wait reading earlier: "When you invoke a tool, you MUST NOT add anything other than the tool invocation itself."

Then the system will handle the rest. Actually the pattern: Assistant sends a tool invocation via JSON object specifying name and arguments. That's all. Then the system receives the tool's execution result and passes it back to the assistant. So we should send the tool invocation. Not the result. Because the system will process it. So we need to produce a single JSON object with name "t_test" and args containing dataset_A and dataset_B. Yes.
